description: Replace a saved dataset's steps with the definition you send (send all of it: read it with get_dataset_definition first, and keep each step's id and the row key unless they must change). Try the changed steps with try_dataset_steps and its uuid before saving. Nothing runs by itself: run_monitor starts a run.

definition.description: The dataset's definition: { inputs, steps, rowKey?, limits? }. Read get_dataset_steps_guide first.

version.description: The version you read with get_dataset_definition: a save over someone else's newer change is refused

name: update_dataset_steps
title: Change a dataset's steps
